# eth_wallet_backend — Ethereum Wallet Backend

> EVM wallet composer over reusable chain, asset, token, account, fee, and transaction-sender modules, with multi-chain balances and activity.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `list_networks` | `list_networks() -> tstr` | Enabled chains selected by the device scope, each carrying its current verdict. |
| `set_chain_enabled` | `set_chain_enabled(chain_id: int, enabled: bool) -> tstr` | Relay the chain registry's enable switch. |
| `set_network_scope` | `set_network_scope(scope: tstr) -> tstr` | Relay the device-wide `mainnets` ¦ `testnets` ¦ `both` scope selector. |
| `verified_proxy_state` | `verified_proxy_state() -> tstr` | `eth_rpc`'s verified-proxy verdict for every enabled in-scope chain: `{ ok, chains: [{ chainId, verdict }] }`. |
| `list_tokens` | `list_tokens(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | Tokens OFFERED on `chain_id`, native first: the built-in rows plus whatever the user turned on. |
| `list_available_tokens` | `list_available_tokens(chain_id: int, query: tstr, offset: int, limit: int) -> tstr` | Every token that COULD be offered on `chain_id`: what the wallet offers now, plus everything `token_list_module` holds for that chain. |
| `set_token_enabled` | `set_token_enabled(chain_id: int, address: tstr, enabled: bool) -> tstr` | Turn a token on or off for `chain_id`. |
| `set_token_sort` | `set_token_sort(order: tstr) -> tstr` | The order `get_balances` returns its rows in — `alpha` or `balance`. |
| `list_accounts` | `list_accounts() -> tstr` | Accounts the keystore holds. |
| `get_account_labels` | `get_account_labels() -> tstr` | Account names, `{ ok, labels: { "<lowercase hex, no 0x>": "<name>" } }`, relayed from the keystore verbatim. |
| `get_account_wallets` | `get_account_wallets() -> tstr` | The WALLET each account was derived under, and where in it: `{ ok, wallets: { "<address>": { "wallet": "<name>", "index": <n> } } }`. |
| `list_contacts` | `list_contacts() -> tstr` | The address book: `{ ok, contacts: [{ address, name }] }`, named rows first and then unnamed, each ordered by name and address so a picker can show them without sorting and the order does not move when an unrelated co… |
| `save_contact` | `save_contact(address: tstr, name: tstr) -> tstr` | Add a contact, or rename one already there — an UPSERT, because a user who saves an address they already have meant to name it. |
| `forget_contact` | `forget_contact(address: tstr) -> tstr` | Forget a contact. |
| `get_balances` | `get_balances(address: tstr) -> tstr` | Native and token balances for `address` on every enabled chain in the device scope. |
| `get_history` | `get_history(address: tstr) -> tstr` | Transactions `tx_sender_module` broadcast for `address` on every chain in the current device scope, newest first — this wallet's own sends and any other app's calls from the same account. |
| `suggest_fees` | `suggest_fees(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | Fee tiers for `chain_id`, from `fee_module`. |
| `prepare_send` | `prepare_send(request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Quote a send without doing anything: resolves the token, checks an ERC-20 balance here, and has `tx_sender_module` price the fee, check the ether and read the nonce. |
| `send` | `send(request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Ask a human to approve a send. |
| `send_status` | `send_status(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Advance a pending send and report where it got to. |
| `cancel_send` | `cancel_send(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Withdraw a send that has not been approved yet, releasing its reserved nonce. |
| `refresh_tx_status` | `refresh_tx_status(address: tstr, hash_hex: tstr) -> tstr` | Re-read one recorded transaction's receipt on ITS OWN chain and update the stored status. |
| `get_tx_details` | `get_tx_details(address: tstr, hash_hex: tstr) -> tstr` | The transaction- and block-level fields a RECEIPT does not carry, for one recorded transaction on ITS OWN chain. |
| `refresh_pending` | `refresh_pending(address: tstr) -> tstr` | Poll receipts for this address's still-pending transactions, on each row's OWN chain, and update their stored status. |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `balances_updated` | `balances_updated(address: tstr)` | A balance may have moved: a transaction this wallet is tracking settled. |
| `tx_status_changed` | `tx_status_changed(hash_hex: tstr)` | Relayed from `tx_sender_module`: a recorded transaction took a hash or settled. |
| `send_status_changed` | `send_status_changed(request_id: tstr)` | Relayed from `tx_sender_module`: a pending send changed state. |
| `accounts_changed` | `accounts_changed(count: int)` | The keystore's accounts moved — the set itself, or the names they are shown under. |
| `tokens_changed` | `tokens_changed(chain_id: int)` | The set of tokens OFFERED on `chain_id` moved. |
| `token_sort_changed` | `token_sort_changed(order: tstr)` | The balance-row order moved. |
| `history_changed` | `history_changed(address: tstr)` | Relayed from `tx_sender_module`: a recorded row for `address` appeared or changed with no hash for `tx_status_changed` to name. |
| `networks_changed` | `networks_changed(chain_id: int)` | What `eth_rpc_module` reports for one chain moved — its endpoint, its transport, or its verified-proxy mode. |
